1: Display a status overlay over top of your flagship when in flight.
2: Display status overlays over top of your escorts when in flight.
3: Display status overlays over top of hostile ships when in flight.
4: Display status overlays over top of friendly and neutral ships when in flight.
5: Display an overlay on hostile missiles. The overlay indicates the danger of the missiles, with more powerful missiles relative to your flagship's HP being indicated more intensely.
6: Display overlays on your flagship's turrets with blindspots. Setting this to "blindspots only" shows the overlays only when the blindspots are blocking the turrets' fire.
7: If an asteroid scanner is installed on your flagship, display an overlay for nearby asteroids.
8: Control whether ships should be highlighted while in flight.
9: - "flagship": a green highlight is applied to your flagship.
10: - "owned ships": your flagship and all the escorts you own will be highlighted.
11: - "all": all ships will have a highlight matching their color on the radar.
12: Rotate the icon for your flagship in the HUD to match your flagship's actual rotation.
13: Display an overlay on nearby landable planets and stations.
14: Control the display of a mini-map of nearby systems.
16: - "when jumping": the mini-map only appears when initiating a hyperspace jump.
17: - "always on": the mini-map is always present when in flight.
18: Activate the ability to send commands to your escorts using the in-system radar mini-map.
19: Control an indicator that occurs when hostile ships enter your current system.
22: - "visual": displays an alert icon by the in-system radar.
23: - "both": both audio and visual indicators occur.
24: Display extra status messages about escorts in your fleet, such as when they are under-crewed or collect flotsam.
25: If active, your flagship will always turn toward your mouse. For activating mouse turning on a key press, see the "Mouse turning (hold)" control.
26: If active, your turrets will target your mouse position. See the "Turret aim override (hold)" keybind to toggle based on a held key.
27: Automatically turn your ship towards your target to aim fixed weapons.
28: If you have multiple fixed weapons with differing projectile velocities, aiming will be done using the weapons with the highest damage per second.
29: If you have any active and loaded non-homing weapons that use ammo, they will be used for aiming in order to make your limited ammunition count, even if your primary weapons have a higher damage per second.
30: Automatically fire your primary weapons if your enemy is within the weapon's range.
31: The strategy that your fleet's turrets use when targeting hostiles.
32: - "focused": all turrets will attack the same target.
33: - "opportunistic": turrets will target ships that they are nearest to aiming at, allowing multiple hostiles to be engaged at once.
34: The strategy that the "Select nearest asteroid" control uses for selecting asteroids.
